article.title: Trump’s Lake Ontario name change clashes with a centuries-old treaty. Google Maps is on the hook, too

It’s an apparent step in his ongoing trade fight with Canada. article.summary: Over the last few days, hundreds of thousands of people have downloaded theMapQuest appfrom the App Store, making it the number one navigation app. There’s one reason why: the OG online mapping company said that it has no plans to rename Lake Ontario after Trump’sexecutive order calling it Lake America.“We saw the president signing the name change executive order, and we had a very quick conversation and immediately came out with a simple statement: We’re not changing it,” says Doug Berger, general manager at MapQuest. “And we were blown away by the trajectory of that post.”If you type “Lake Ontario” into Google Maps, by contrast, it now autocorrects to “Lake America”—at least if you’re in the U.S. In Canada, Google Maps still shows it as Lake Ontario.
